title: A scalar coarse meter can preserve unknown logical coherence
statement: For H_DM=a0 ND I+chi QD ZM,chi=J/2,QD=+/-2 on code and0 adjacent,scalar area alpha gives M0=Padj+cos(2alpha)Pcode,M1=-i sin(2alpha)ZL Pcode. Known Pauli preserves accepted code coherence and adjacent charge never falsely accepts in ideal model. Actual scalar areas in[pi/8,3pi/8] yield all-no <=2^-M and expected probes<=2,provided gain box ratio<=3. Spectrum-only quantum gain is insufficient: correlated Bell logical/gain with areas pi/8,pi/4 yields weights1/3,2/3 and trace distance1/6. Known meter bit1 can replace0 with changed accepted output; actual failed adjacent meters still require reset/record renewal. No diagnosis of wrong local particle number,wrong rails or orbital excitation.
